definition: Run the corrective rounds with the proof: before any declared move the solver is asked to prove the placement, so each round is judged against a proved house. It takes minutes rather than seconds, and shows each round as it lands.
basis: Our wording of the loop with the proof. docs/revise.md: "Accept only if the key strictly decreases and no new fatal appears." and "proof is to be had it is asked for before any declared move".
